kpis.label: European allies pledged at The Hague to reach 3.5% of GDP core defence spending by 2035; Germany is targeting 2029 on a €108B 2026 defence budget (+25% YoY), so the European demand runway is intact even as listed European names de-rate on execution

kpis.sub: 2026 YTD · DEFENSE TECH VC, PAST 2025'S $9.6B FULL-YEAR RECORD
kpis.label: Early-stage rounds are pricing at 17x-50x revenue; Anduril's raise at ~$100B (first reported Jul 24, vs. a $61B mark set about two months earlier) is still unclosed roughly ten weeks on, with one proposed structure tying a later, higher valuation to financial benchmarks

The stopgap blocks new program starts: Golden Dome has under $400M of base-budget authority with ~$17.1B of its $17.5B request dependent on a reconciliation bill, and the $54.6B FY27 DAWG drone line cannot begin; Pentagon leadership has warned of a $500B-$700B gap between plans and likely appropriations

kpis.sub: ANDURIL'S AIR FORCE CCA PRODUCTION AWARD · SEP 26
kpis.label: The Air Force named Anduril's FQ-44A Fury and General Atomics' FQ-42A Vengeance for CCA production — 150 airframes initially, scaling toward 500 by 2032 at roughly $20M/unit, split between the two — a production milestone that supports an eventual Anduril IPO regardless of when its private round closes

tiers.label: Established / Software & Primes
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Shares near $188.77 (Oct 2) sit between a ~$219 bull case and a ~$170 bear case; Q2 revenue grew 92.8% to $1.935B (U.S. commercial +149%) and full-year guidance implies ~82% growth, but at ~85x forward earnings the consensus target of ~$196 implies only modest upside
rows.watch for: A 160x trailing P/E, ~$265M of quarterly stock-based compensation and government-contract termination risk; CEO Alex Karp's Sep 17 comment that leading AI labs may need to be nationalized remains a regulatory-risk thread, and the stock is ~9% below its $207.52 high

rows.angle: Shares closed at €959.80 (Oct 2) — down ~38% year-to-date and less than half the €2,007 high set in October 2025 — even as the order backlog stands at €80.5B; CEO Armin Papperger bought €499K of stock this week and a supervisory-board-linked foundation also bought, a mildly constructive signal
rows.watch for: Q3 results on Nov 5 will test backlog quality and cash conversion; delivery delays on wheeled vehicles and Skyranger, suspected plate quality issues, negative operating free cash flow and July's loss of the €12.8B F126 frigate program all remain unresolved

rows.angle: Shares at $236.64 (Oct 2) trade near the bottom of a $234-$379 52-week range, ~22% down YTD on ~19.9x forward earnings; a seven-year, ~$6B Lockheed Martin THAAD propulsion contract (undefinitized) and a $1B Pentagon convertible investment in the Missile Solutions unit (IPO now mid-2027) support the case
rows.watch for: The CR freezes new starts including $921.9M of THAAD production, Golden Dome is largely suspended, and the Kubasik exit (replaced by CEO Sam Mehta in August after a conduct review) is still not fully explained; consensus target ~$356 implies large upside only if funding resumes

rows.angle: No fresh price data could be confirmed this week; last confirmed, shares were holding a September recovery in the mid-2,000s pence range, backed by a record £84.0B H1 order backlog and July's raised full-year guidance (8-10% sales growth, 11-13% EPS growth)
rows.watch for: Roughly half of revenue is U.S.-linked, so the CR and FY27 appropriations fight matters; H2 execution against raised guidance is unproven and the market has stopped rewarding order announcements on their own

tiers.label: High-Growth Autonomy Pure-Plays
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Shares at $140.31 (Oct 1) trade below both the 50-day ($158.54) and 200-day ($171.12) averages and are ~42% down YTD, despite the Sep 9 quarterly beat ($0.59 EPS vs. $0.22 expected; $480.5M revenue vs. $452M) and the $464.8M Army LOCUST laser award; consensus target ~$232
rows.watch for: Stifel and Piper Sandler recently cut targets (to $220 and $235), the earlier BADGER/SCAR cancellation and goodwill impairment still weigh, and the CR delays new autonomy program starts the growth story depends on

rows.angle: Shares around $51 after a ~$35M hardware award; the Orbit Communications acquisition closed in August, JDAM-ER propulsion and a Marine Corps unmanned deal add breadth, and the CCA production decision keeps engine optionality (GE GEK800) alive; the popular fair-value narrative of ~$105 depends on ambitious growth and margin assumptions
rows.watch for: At ~6.3x sales versus an industry average of ~4.6x, the stock needs backlog-to-revenue conversion; Kratos again did not place on the Gauntlet II leaderboard, and the CR delays new starts

rows.angle: Shares are ~20% down YTD, the least bad of the big three drone names, but H1 revenue was only $35.7M against a $150M full-year target — Red Cat needs a very steep H2 ramp, with the U.S. Army roughly half of H1 sales; Teal Drones missed the top five in Gauntlet II, where private Neros took a ~$100M, 14,000-drone order
rows.watch for: Revenue conversion from the Blue Ops/Havoc maritime and Apium swarm stories, further insider sales, and the next Gauntlet round

rows.angle: Shares are ~26% down YTD even though management raised its 2026 revenue outlook and cites a pro forma backlog of ~$757M (partly acquired); Ascent Aerosystems missed the Gauntlet II Deep Strike top five, but counter-UAS and loitering-munitions work continues
rows.watch for: The H2 ramp needed to hit the raised outlook, dilution/insider sales (a Form 144 filing and the Q2 EPS miss of -$0.19 vs. -$0.13), and reliance on acquired backlog

private_watchlist.name: Anduril
private_watchlist.note: Talks first reported Jul 24 (following a $5B round at $61B led by Thrive and a16z about two months earlier) remain unclosed; one proposed structure would commit investors to a later, higher-valued round tied to financial benchmarks. 2025 revenue was $2.2B, and the Sep 26 CCA production award (up to ~$5B split with General Atomics) is real production revenue regardless of when the round closes.

private_watchlist.name: Shield AI
private_watchlist.note: No new financing this period; still marked by the ~$2B round at $12.7B. Competes for the Navy's up-to-$800M ISR task-order pool with V-BAT alongside NATO eastern-flank orders.

private_watchlist.name: Saronic
private_watchlist.note: No new financing this period; still marked by the $1.75B Series D plus an early-September add-on. Building out its Port of Gulfport site toward 20+ autonomous surface vessels a year by 2027.

private_watchlist.name: Helsing
private_watchlist.note: No new financing this period; still marked by the $1.8B round closed Jul 13, the largest defence-tech round in European history. Continues fielding the HX-2 strike drone in Ukraine.

bear_case.title: The stopgap budget freezes the programs the growth stories depend on
bear_case.description: The continuing resolution runs to Dec 11 and blocks new starts for 150+ programs; Golden Dome has under $400M of base-budget authority against a $17.5B request (~$17.1B needs reconciliation), the $54.6B DAWG drone line cannot begin, and Pentagon leadership has flagged a $500B-$700B gap between plans and likely appropriations.
bear_case.counter: Congress has historically backfilled priority programs after a CR, and the reconciliation route could still deliver Golden Dome funding.

bear_case.title: Public-market valuations remain stretched
bear_case.description: Palantir at ~$189 trades near 85x forward earnings (160x trailing) and the S&P Aerospace & Defense sub-index sits near 32x forward earnings versus roughly 20x for the S&P 500 — a premium the sector has to keep earning.
bear_case.counter: Palantir's 92.8% revenue growth and rising EPS estimates are far faster than higher-multiple software peers.

bear_case.title: Private-market valuations are drawing bubble comparisons of their own
bear_case.description: Early-stage rounds price at 17x-50x revenue, Anduril's ~$100B target remains unclosed ten weeks on, and the Bank for International Settlements has compared the sector's pricing to the AI-infrastructure buildout it already calls bubble-like.

bear_case.title: The Pentagon's drone competitions keep favoring private newcomers over listed pure-plays
bear_case.description: Gauntlet II leaders Neros and Perennial Autonomy won real orders (Neros: ~$100M for 14,000+ FPV drones on Oct 1), while Red Cat's Teal Drones, Ondas's Ascent Aerosystems and Kratos all missed the top five.

bear_case.title: Contract wins and beats aren't rescuing the pure-play stocks
bear_case.description: AeroVironment beat Q2 estimates ($0.59 vs. $0.22 EPS) and won a $464.8M laser award yet trades at $140, ~42% down YTD and below its 50- and 200-day averages after Stifel and Piper Sandler cut targets.
bear_case.counter: The ~$232 consensus target implies substantial upside if backlog converts to earnings.

bear_case.title: Rheinmetall's backlog no longer moves the stock — execution does
bear_case.description: A €80.5B backlog hasn't stopped a ~38% YTD slide to €959.80; delivery delays, quality concerns, negative operating free cash flow and the F126 loss are the focus ahead of Nov 5 Q3 results.
bear_case.counter: CEO and board-linked insider purchases this week suggest management sees the de-rating as overdone.

catalysts.title: Pentagon awards Neros ~$100M for 14,000+ FPV drones after Gauntlet II
catalysts.description: A private company, not a listed pure-play, captured the first big production order from the Drone Dominance Program; Red Cat, Ondas and Kratos missed the top five.

catalysts.title: Continuing resolution to Dec 11 delays 150+ new programs
catalysts.description: Golden Dome (~$17.1B reconciliation-dependent) and the $54.6B DAWG drone line cannot start; THAAD production ($921.9M) and M-SHORAD Inc. 4 are among frozen new starts.

catalysts.title: L3Harris lands ~$6B seven-year THAAD propulsion contract from Lockheed Martin
catalysts.description: Undefinitized, with terms due by late 2026; the Pentagon also holds a $1B convertible stake in the Missile Solutions unit, whose IPO has slipped to mid-2027.

catalysts.title: Anduril's FQ-44A Fury wins Air Force CCA production
catalysts.description: Up to ~$5B split with General Atomics across 150 initial airframes (scaling to 500 by 2032), plus a separate autonomy-software award.

catalysts.title: Rheinmetall CEO and board-linked foundation buy stock
catalysts.description: Papperger bought 525 shares (~€499K) with shares at ~€960, down ~38% YTD; a new Nordic site and a U.S. Army mounts order also announced.

catalysts.title: Upcoming: Rheinmetall Q3 2026 results
catalysts.description: Investors will scrutinize backlog composition and cash conversion after months of execution concerns.

etfs.summary: ~$12.3B AUM, 0.37% expense ratio, ~0.3% yield, ~98% industrials (GE Aerospace, RTX, Boeing); the lower-cost, steadier broad-primes option, closed near $207.79 on Oct 2

etfs.name: Invesco Aerospace & Defense
etfs.summary: Last confirmed ~$8.4B AUM and 0.58% expense ratio (not refreshed this week); a broader commercial-aerospace tilt tempers pure-play defense-tech volatility

etfs.name: Select STOXX Europe Defense
etfs.summary: Last confirmed ~$1.2B AUM across 23 holdings and 0.50% expense ratio (not refreshed this week); the pure European play, caught between BAE's steadier tape and Rheinmetall's execution concerns

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: BAE Systems
positions.note: No fresh price could be confirmed this week, but the record £84.0B H1 backlog and raised full-year guidance are unchanged and nothing this week contradicts the thesis — still the least-disputed name here, with the watch-point being roughly half of revenue tied to a U.S. budget stuck in a CR. Directly accessible on UK platforms with no wrapper needed.

positions.name: Kratos Defense
positions.note: The Sep 26 CCA production award keeps GE GEK800 engine optionality alive and the ~$35M award and Orbit deal add breadth, but at ~6.3x sales versus 4.6x for the industry, ~$51 shares still need backlog conversion, Kratos again missed the Gauntlet II board, and the Dec 11 CR delays new starts. Also sits in the Robotics sleeve — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: AeroVironment
positions.note: A Sep 9 beat ($0.59 vs. $0.22 EPS) and the $464.8M laser award haven't stopped a slide to $140.31 (~42% down YTD, below both moving averages) as Stifel and Piper cut targets — small size only until execution shows up. Also sits in the Robotics sleeve — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: L3Harris
positions.note: At $236.64 (~19.9x forward earnings, ~22% down YTD) the valuation has genuinely reset and the ~$6B THAAD propulsion contract is real, but the CR freezes new THAAD production starts and Golden Dome funding, and the Kubasik exit is still not fully explained — a price worth watching, not yet a thesis that's confirmed. Also sits in the Space sleeve via satellite work — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: Rheinmetall
positions.note: CEO Papperger's ~€499K purchase at ~€960 (down ~38% YTD) is a mildly constructive signal, but delivery delays, negative free cash flow and the F126 loss are unresolved until Q3 results on Nov 5 — wait for evidence. Directly accessible from the UK without a wrapper.

positions.name: Palantir
positions.note: Growth is exceptional (Q2 revenue +92.8%, U.S. commercial +149%) but at ~$189 and ~85x forward earnings, with consensus targets only ~4% above the price, the stock is priced for perfection. Also anchors the AI sleeve — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: Ondas Holdings
positions.note: Management raised 2026 guidance and cites a ~$757M pro forma backlog, but much of it is acquired, the stock is ~26% down YTD and Ascent Aerosystems missed the Gauntlet II top five — the evidence still doesn't support owning it here. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: Red Cat Holdings
positions.note: H1 revenue of $35.7M against a $150M full-year target needs an unusually steep H2 ramp, and Teal Drones missed the Gauntlet II podium while private Neros took a ~$100M, 14,000-drone order — the research doesn't support owning it here. Needs a US wrapper.
